comment: Variation of whatis-inventory-keeps-map-over-three-line-status with statuslines:2: the inventory menu's (end) footer is on row 22, the first of two status rows, so docorner() clears both status suffixes from offx - 1, and the map ends on row 21 above them. bot() stays disabled through select_menu(), so both suffixes remain blank beside the data-base text window until its dismissal redraws the status.
